3416.title: Northern Lights (Aurora Borealis) in Slovenia – May 2024
3416.summary: Seeing the northern lights here is unusual, but because solar eruptions have been more frequent in the current period, we have been able to observe them three times since last year. The Sun reverses its magnetic…

content.source: Opazovati severni sij v naših krajih je nekaj neobičajnega, vendar zaradi pogostejših sončevih izbruhov v trenutnem obdobju, smo ga lahko od lani opazovali že tretjič. Sonce namreč na približno 11 let zamenja magnetni pol, kar pa poviša aktivnost izstrelkov sončeve plazme (CME). Trenutno smo na vrhuncu tega obdobja, zato ni izključena možnost, da se v kratkem pojavi še kakšen tak dogodek.
content.translation: Seeing the northern lights here is unusual, but because solar eruptions have been more frequent in the current period, we have been able to observe them three times since last year. The Sun reverses its magnetic poles roughly every 11 years, which increases the activity of coronal mass ejections (CMEs). We are currently at the peak of this period, so another such event may occur soon.

content.source: V noči na 11. maj sem bil pripravljen, z nekaj idejami za motiv. Pestro je bilo do jutra, vendar sem malo po dveh zjutraj zaključil in samo še posnel "time-lapse" iz okna, ki je snemal do jutra.
content.translation: On the night leading into 11 May I was prepared, with a few ideas for subjects. It stayed lively until morning, but I finished shortly after two and only left a time-lapse running from the window until dawn.

content.source: Severni sij sem tako "zares" videl prvič v življenju šele danes, in to s prostim očesom. Nebo se je obarvalo v rožnato in "zagorelo" v belih plamenih.
content.translation: So today was the first time in my life that I had truly seen the northern lights, and with the naked eye. The sky turned pink and blazed with white flames.

3318.title: Kačna Cave
3318.summary: Kačna Cave was on my list almost as soon as I took up caving, as my fellow club members immediately told me about the world's best photograph by Robbie Shone, which has already won countless awards and…

content.source: Kačno jamo sem imel na seznamu praktično takoj, ko sem lotil jamarstva, saj sem bil tudi od soklubašev takoj obveščen o najboljši fotografiji na svetu avtorja
content.translation: Kačna Cave was on my list almost as soon as I took up caving, as my fellow club members immediately told me about the world's best photograph by

content.source: Robbieja Schonea
content.translation: Robbie Shone

content.source: , ki je požela že nešteto nagrad in priznanj.
content.translation: , which has already won countless awards and distinctions.

content.source: Kot govori stari pregovor, običajno pripisan Pablu Picassotu -
content.translation: As the old saying, usually attributed to Pablo Picasso, goes –

content.source: dobri avtorji posnemajo, vrhunski avtorji kradejo
content.translation: good artists copy, great artists steal

content.source: , sem skušal ukrasti idejo in posnemati izdelek.
content.translation: , I tried to steal the idea and imitate the result.

content.source: Takoj na vrhu 200 metrškega direktnega spusta, že na ferati, sem dobil lekcijo, koliko me je v hlačah, in da bi poleg stativa moral s seboj vzeti tudi plenice. Izgovarjam se tudi, da so se mi fotografski plani izjalovili zaradi nenapovedane skupine Italijanskih jamarjev, ki so prišli nekaj minut pred nami, in že opremljali desni, stopničast rov (lisična?).
content.translation: Right at the top of the 200-metre direct descent, already on the via ferrata, I learnt just how much courage I had in my trousers, and that I should have brought nappies as well as the tripod. My excuse is also that my photography plans were thwarted by an unannounced group of Italian cavers who arrived a few minutes before us and were already rigging the stepped passage on the right (Lisična?).

content.source: Mi smo šli po levem - direktnem, kjer smo se samo kakšne 4x prepenjali; brez poličk za počivanje.
content.translation: We took the left-hand, direct route, where we only changed over about four times, with no ledges for resting.

content.source: Vseeno smo poskusili narediti nekaj fotk obeh brezen, rezultati niso takšni kot sem upal, ampak kljub temu, da sem se za dol tresel, za gor pa preklinjal, je bil dober trening.
content.translation: We still tried to take a few photos of both shafts. The results are not what I had hoped for, but despite trembling on the way down and swearing on the way up, it was good training.

content.source: Hvala ekipa - Jure, Jaroš, Aljaž in Anže.
content.translation: Thanks to the team – Jure, Jaroš, Aljaž and Anže.

content.source: P.S. Seveda smo malo fotkali tudi kakšne kapnike, in ekipo.
content.translation: P.S. Of course, we also photographed a few speleothems and the team.

3271.title: Second National Geographic Win
3271.summary: After last year's win (archive) in the 2022 National Geographic photo competition, I was convinced it could not happen again this year. Surely someone else has to get a chance, right? Last year's winning photograph…

content.source: Z
content.translation: After

content.source: ) na fotonatečaju National Geographic 2022, sem bil prepričan, da se letos to ne more ponoviti. Saj vendar mora še kdo drug dobiti priložnost, kajne?
content.translation: ) in the 2022 National Geographic photo competition, I was convinced it could not happen again this year. Surely someone else has to get a chance, right?

content.source: Lanskoletna zmagovalna fotografija natečaja
content.translation: Last year's winning photograph in the

content.source: National Geographic 2022
content.translation: 2022 National Geographic competition

content.source: CERKNIŠKO POLJE
content.translation: CERKNIŠKO POLJE

content.source: Presihajoče Cerkniško jezero je fenomen kraških pojavov, saj voda na krasu običajno ne zastaja. Presihanje je začel preučevati že Valvasor, ki si je zamislil sistem podzemnih jezer. Kot dobra znanstvena fantastika je njegova razlaga začinjena z delčki resnice.
content.translation: Lake Cerknica is an exceptional example of an intermittent karst lake, since water does not usually remain on the karst surface. Valvasor began studying its intermittent behaviour and imagined a system of underground lakes. Like good science fiction, his explanation is seasoned with grains of truth.

content.source: A ko sem pred samo razglasitvijo dobil e-mail organizatorja, naj priložim originalno (RAW) verzijo svoje fotografije, sem posumil, da sem očitno spet v ožjem izboru. Nato me je pa nekaj dni pred samo razglasitvijo presenetil ponoven e-mail, da je moja fotografija
content.translation: But when, just before the announcement, I received an email from the organiser asking me to submit the original (RAW) version of my photograph, I suspected that I was apparently shortlisted again. Then, a few days before the announcement itself, another email surprised me by saying that my photograph

content.source: RAZSVETLJENJE (Vse Mlečne ceste vodijo v Rakov Škocjan)
content.translation: ENLIGHTENED (All Milky Ways Lead to Rakov Škocjan)

content.source: zmagala v kategoriji Pokrajina. Od tu dalje sem e-mail nehal brati, se sam pri sebi hudomušno namuznil in povedal ženi za dosežek. Čez par ur sem ponovno odprl mail, ter večkrat natančno prebral naslednji stavek.
content.translation: had won the Landscape category. At that point I stopped reading the email, grinned mischievously to myself and told my wife about the achievement. A few hours later I opened the email again and carefully reread the following sentence several times.

content.source: Spet?
content.translation: Again?

content.source: Neverjetno!
content.translation: Unbelievable!

content.source: Na podelitvi sem enostavno moral izvedeti, kako je žirija ocenjevala. In pošten odgovor ni razočaral. Žirija je dobila poleg fotografije samo informacijo o naslovu in opisu fotografije. Imen ni bilo zraven. Vsak žirant je glasoval za zmagovalno fotografijo znotraj svoje kategorije, nato so pa zmagovalca celotnega natečaja iz izbranih del določili skupaj. Za imena so izvedeli šele, ko so svoje odločitve sporočili organizatorju.
content.translation: At the ceremony I simply had to find out how the jury had judged the entries. And the honest answer did not disappoint. Alongside each photograph, the jury received only its title and description. There were no names attached. Each juror voted for the winning photograph in their category, then they jointly selected the overall competition winner from those works. They learnt the names only after reporting their decisions to the organiser.

content.source: RAZSVETLJENJE
content.translation: ENLIGHTENED

content.source: Vse Mlečne ceste vodijo v Rakov Škocjan
content.translation: All Milky Ways Lead to Rakov Škocjan

content.source: Fotografija je nastala na neko avgustovsko noč, ko sem se odločil fotografirati sceno pod Malim naravnim mostom v Rakovem Škocjanu ponoči, a kot sem že napisal na
content.translation: The photograph was made one August night, when I decided to photograph the scene beneath the Small Natural Bridge in Rakov Škocjan at night, but, as I already wrote on

content.source: Instagramu
content.translation: Instagram

content.source: , z dvema ciljema. Želel sem na fotografiji uprizoriti veliko "drame", ter želel sem, da bi bila na nebu vidna Mlečna cesta. Z Aninim potrpljenjem, ki je morala za vsak poskus 30 sekund nepremično pozirati, sva naredila nekaj različnih variant, in eno od teh sem poslal na natečaj. Ostale so pa tu spodaj.
content.translation: , with two aims. I wanted to create plenty of "drama" in the photograph, and I wanted the Milky Way to be visible in the sky. Thanks to Ana's patience—she had to pose completely still for 30 seconds for every attempt—we made several different versions, and I submitted one of them to the competition. The others are below.

content.source: Pa še nekaj fotografij iz podelitve, kjer je bila dvorana v Smeltu nabito polna, da nisva imela več kje sedeti. Pred podelitvijo so nam postregli še z odličnimi predavanji z vrhunskimi fotografijami. Predavali so: Ami Vitale, Arne Hodalič, Davorin Tome in Ivan Šprajc.
content.translation: And a few photographs from the ceremony, where the hall at Smelt was so packed that we had nowhere left to sit. Before the awards, we were also treated to excellent talks featuring superb photography. The speakers were Ami Vitale, Arne Hodalič, Davorin Tome and Ivan Šprajc.

content.source: V medijih so zapisali...
content.translation: The media wrote…

content.source: Pa drugo leto spet???
content.translation: And again next year???

3234.title: Storm over Nanos
3234.summary: The storm system that developed over the Po Valley in the second week of July and was persistently carried into Slovenia by the westerly wind largely bypassed the southern/coastal part of Slovenia. The more severe storms and damage were in the…

content.source: Nevihtni sistem ki se je v drugem tednu julija razvijal v Padski nižini in ga je zahodni veter vztrajno prinašal v Slovenijo, je v večini obšel južni / primorski del Slovenije. Večja neurja in škoda je bila na na severovzhodni strani kraškega roba - na gorenjskem, dolenjskem štajerskem in v prekmurju.
content.translation: The storm system that developed over the Po Valley in the second week of July and was persistently carried into Slovenia by the westerly wind largely bypassed the southern/coastal part of Slovenia. The more severe storms and damage were on the north-eastern side of the Karst Rim—in Upper Carniola, Lower Carniola, Styria and Prekmurje.

content.source: Na zadnji dan večjih neviht pa je sistem dosegel tudi primorski del, s pravo predstavo strel, ampak na srečo brez večjih posledic.
content.translation: On the final day of the major storms, however, the system also reached the coastal region, putting on a real lightning show but fortunately causing no serious consequences.

3161.title: The Witches of Slivnica on Ice
3161.summary: This time, the witch Uršula left her home on Slivnica to go skating on frozen Lake Cerknica. With a magic spell, they can even place Triglav right beside the lake, as the last photographs show.

content.source: Coprnica Uršula se je tokrat iz njenega doma na Slivnici odpravila na drsanje na zamrznjenem Cerkniškem jezeru.
content.translation: This time, the witch Uršula left her home on Slivnica to go skating on frozen Lake Cerknica.

content.source: S čarobnim urokom znajo tudi postaviti Triglav tik ob jezeru, kar je razvidno iz zadnjih fotografij.
content.translation: With a magic spell, they can even place Triglav right beside the lake, as the last photographs show.

3110.title: Flamingo Invasion
3110.summary: When news began to spread that real flamingos had appeared at Lake Cerknica, we decided to reveal our closely guarded secret. We had been hiding the flamingos all summer…

content.source: Ko so se začele širiti novice, da so se na Cerkniškem jezeru pojavili pravi pravcati Plamenci, oziroma kot jim raje rečemo Flamingoti, smo se odločili razkriti našo skrbno varovano skrivnost.
content.translation: When news began to spread that real, genuine flamingos had appeared at Lake Cerknica—or Flamingoti, as we prefer to call them—we decided to reveal our closely guarded secret.

content.source: Flamingote smo celo poletje skrivali v Zelških jamah! Očitno so nam ušli!
content.translation: We had been hiding the flamingos in Zelške Caves all summer! Apparently they escaped!

content.source: Poleti smo z Matejevim plamencem in mojim zelo potrpežljivim modelom - Ano - imeli "foto sešn" v jamskem sistemu pri Rakovem škocjanu. Nastalo je nekaj lepih fotografij, tako pred in za-kulisjem.
content.translation: In the summer, Matej's flamingo, my very patient model Ana and I held a "photo sesh" in the cave system at Rakov Škocjan. We made some lovely photographs, both in front of and behind the scenes.

content.source: Otroci, ne počnite tega doma! Mi smo eksperti! Jame so smrtno nevarne, poleg tega pa tudi zelo občutljive na človeške dejavnosti!
content.translation: Children, don't try this at home! We're experts! Caves can be deadly, and they are also extremely sensitive to human activity!

content.source: Med fotografiranjem smo v jami skrbno ravnali in iz jame odnesli več plastike, kot smo jo prinesli. Pustili smo samo kakšen čeveljni odtis, ubili pa smo samo čas.
content.translation: We treated the cave with care while photographing and carried out more plastic than we brought in. We left only the odd boot print and killed only time.

content.source: Šalo na stran, glede jam pa resno - naj fotografije ne služijo kot pobudnica norčijam v jamah. Smo izurjeni in izšolani jamarji, ki smo se le malce pozabavali na koncu obiska jame z znanstvenimi nameni - vzorčenju hidrogeoloških meritev.
content.translation: Joking aside, let us be serious about caves: these photographs should not encourage fooling around underground. We are trained cavers who merely had a little fun at the end of a cave visit made for scientific purposes—sampling for hydrogeological measurements.

content.source: V zakulisju...
content.translation: Behind the scenes…

2995.title: Ocizeljska Cave
2995.summary: The Beka–Ocizla cave system developed in the contact zone between Palaeocene limestone and Eocene flysch at an elevation of 350 m in south-western Slovenia. The system connects Ocizeljska Cave, Blažev Spodmol,…

content.source: Beško-Ocizeljski jamski sistem je razvit v območju kontakta med paleocenskim apnencem in eocenskim flišem na nadmorski višini 350 m na jugozahodu Slovenije.
content.translation: The Beka–Ocizla cave system developed in the contact zone between Palaeocene limestone and Eocene flysch at an elevation of 350 m in south-western Slovenia.

content.source: V jamski sistem se povezujejo Ocizeljska jama, Blažev spodmol, Maletova jama s slapom, Jama z naravnim mostom, Jurjeva jama v Lokah in Jama S-4/Socerb od katerih vhodi v štiri jame delujejo kot občasen ponor. Skrajna vhoda sta drug od drugega oddaljena 500 m.
content.translation: The cave system connects Ocizeljska Cave, Blažev Spodmol, Maletova Cave with its waterfall, the Cave with a Natural Bridge, Jurjeva Cave in Loke and Cave S-4/Socerb; the entrances to four of these act as occasional sinks. The two outermost entrances are 500 m apart.

content.source: V Ocizeljsko jamo smo z Ano in Cyrilom vstopili skozi Blažev spodmol, nato po kratkem prihodu na površje nadaljevali pot v Ocizeljsko jamo. Šli smo do preloma. Lepa in ne pregloboka jama je primerna za vadbo opremljanja in razopremljanja vrvi.
content.translation: Ana, Cyril and I entered the system through Blažev Spodmol, then briefly emerged at the surface before continuing into Ocizeljska Cave. We went as far as the fault. This beautiful and not overly deep cave is suitable for practising rigging and derigging ropes.

content.source: Na poti ven je na vrhu jaška Ani grdo spodrsnilo (kjer je fotografirana), da je padla nazaj v brezno, a na srečo ne globoko, ker je bila dvakrat varovana in tudi nikamor se ni udarila.
content.translation: On the way out, Ana slipped badly at the top of the shaft (where she is pictured) and fell back into it, but fortunately not far because she was secured twice, and she did not hit anything.

2946.title: The Hundredth Cave
2946.summary: Jama pod Turkovo ogrado, also known as Jama na Grahovnki, is number 100 in the cave register and therefore appears on maps as the Hundredth Cave. It is 100 metres long :) and 23 metres deep. It lies beyond…

content.source: Jama pod Turkovo ogrado / Jama na Grahovnki je vpisana pod zaporedno številko 100 v katastru jam, zato se na zemljevidih pojavlja tudi pod imenom Stota jama. Dolga je
content.translation: Jama pod Turkovo ogrado, also known as Jama na Grahovnki, is registered as number 100 in the cave register and therefore appears on maps under the name the Hundredth Cave. It is

content.source: 100 metrov
content.translation: 100 metres

content.source: :) in globoka 23 metrov.
content.translation: :) long and 23 metres deep.

content.source: Nahaja se za vasjo Laze pri Planinskem polju, kakšen kilometer stran od bolj znanih jam na tem koncu, npr. Vranja jama, Skednena jama in Najdena jama
content.translation: It lies beyond the village of Laze by Planina Polje, about a kilometre from the better-known caves in this area, such as Vranja Cave, Skednena Cave and Najdena Cave.

2883.title: Medvedjak
2883.summary: Medvedova Cave near Markovščina, or Skadanščina, has several beautiful chambers with speleothems. It is entered by rope through a 40-metre shaft. While waiting for 20 other cavers to ascend and descend the rope, I had…

content.source: Medvedova jama pri Markovščini oz. Skadanščini ima nekaj lepih kapniških dvoran. Vanjo se vstopi po vrvi, skozi 40 metrov visoko brezno.
content.translation: Medvedova Cave near Markovščina, or Skadanščina, has several beautiful chambers with speleothems. It is entered by rope through a 40-metre shaft.

content.source: Med čakanjem, ko se je še 20 drugih jamarjev dvigalo in spuščalo po vrvi sem imel čas narediti nekaj fotk.
content.translation: While waiting for 20 other cavers to ascend and descend the rope, I had time to take a few photographs.

content.source: Po ogledu jame Medvedjak smo odplezali nazaj na površje in si na hitro ogledali še majhno a tudi lepo jamo Mt 11.
content.translation: After visiting Medvedjak Cave, we climbed back to the surface and had a quick look at the small but also beautiful Mt 11 Cave.

1630.title: Vranja Cave
1630.summary: Vranja Cave has an intermittent stream. It was discovered in 1958 and is open for unrestricted entry. It lies on the northern edge of Planina Polje. Following the left-hand passage through Vranja Cave leads up a ladder…

content.source: Vranja jama je jama z občasnim tokom. Odkrita je bila leta 1958. Jama je odprta, s prostim vstopom. Nahaja se na severnem robu planinskega polja.
content.translation: Vranja Cave has an intermittent stream. It was discovered in 1958 and is open for unrestricted entry. It lies on the northern edge of Planina Polje.

content.source: Če pot skozi Vranjo jamo nadaljujemo po levem rovu, pridemo po lestvi gor v novo dvorano - Mrzla jama, z izhodom na Planinsko polje, nad Putikove Štirne.
content.translation: If we continue through Vranja Cave along the left-hand passage, a ladder takes us up into a new chamber—Mrzla Cave—with an exit onto Planina Polje above Putikove Štirne.

content.source: V Vranji jami sva našla poslikave sodobnega jamskega človeka. Iz tega odkritja sklepava, da ta primitivna človeška vrsta še ni izumrla :)
content.translation: In Vranja Cave we found paintings by modern cave people. From this discovery, we conclude that this primitive human species has not yet died out :)

1736.title: Herons and Storks of Planina Polje
1736.summary: On our first photographic hunt at Planina Polje, we found several bird species—herons and storks then in their migration period. Before spotting the first heron, a roe deer posed for us with its tongue out and a…

content.source: Na fotolovu na Planinskem polju sva v prvem poskusu našla kar nekaj različnih vrst ptic - čaplje in štorklje, ki so ravno v selitvenem obdobju.
content.translation: On our first photographic hunt at Planina Polje, we found several bird species—herons and storks then in their migration period.

content.source: Predno sva pa opazila prvo čapljo, nama je pa pozirala srna z iztegnjenim jezikom in suštrano zadnjico.
content.translation: Before we spotted the first heron, a roe deer posed for us with its tongue out and a tousled backside.

content.source: Ujela sva malo belo čapljo (Egretta garzetta / little egret), medtem ko se je pokakala v zraku.
content.translation: We caught a little egret (Egretta garzetta) relieving itself in mid-air.

content.source: Splašila sva rjavo čapljo (Ardea purpurea / purple heron), ki izgleda kot dinozaver.
content.translation: We startled a purple heron (Ardea purpurea), which looks like a dinosaur.

content.source: Visoko nad nama je jadrala črna štorklja (Ciconia nigra / black stork).
content.translation: A black stork (Ciconia nigra) soared high above us.

content.source: Za zaključek sva pa na dimniku v Planini opazila, da je gnezdo ponovno zasedeno. V to 20 let staro gnezdo se vsako leto vrača ista družina. Bele štorklje (Ciconia ciconia / white stork) vsako leto gnezdo tudi malenkost povečajo.
content.translation: To finish, we noticed that the nest on a chimney in Planina was occupied again. The same family returns to this 20-year-old nest every year. The white storks (Ciconia ciconia) also enlarge the nest slightly each year.

1848.title: Unška Collapse Doline
1848.summary: Unška Collapse Doline is a collapse feature up to 125 metres deep, formed when the roof of a large underground chamber of the River Rak caved in. On its eastern side, behind sheer walls, underground military bunkers extend…

content.source: Unška koliševka je do 125 m globoka jama udornica, ki je nastala s podrtjem stropa v veliki podzemni dvorani reke Rak.
content.translation: Unška Collapse Doline is a collapse feature up to 125 metres deep, formed when the roof of a large underground chamber of the River Rak caved in.

content.source: Na vzhodni strani, za navpičnimi stenami se raztezajo podzemni vojaški bunkerji, ki so nastali med obema vojnama. Obstajalo naj bi 15 km rovov, vendar so jih kasneje zabetonirali in zalili z vodo, tako da je za ogled ostalo še približno 1,5 km rovov.
content.translation: On its eastern side, behind sheer walls, underground military bunkers built between the two world wars extend below ground. There were reportedly 15 kilometres of tunnels, but they were later sealed with concrete and flooded, leaving about 1.5 kilometres open to visitors.

2379.title: Zelške Caves
2379.summary: Matej Blatnik took us to see one of the lovelier and easier caves nearby—Zelške Caves. We entered beneath the Small Natural Bridge in Rakov Škocjan. Outside, we inflated a small boat and paddled in. Zelške Caves are…

content.source: Matej Blatnik naju je peljal pogledat eno lepših in enostavnih jam tu okrog - v Zelške jame. Vanjo smo vstopili pod malim naravnim mostom v Rakovem škocjanu. Zunaj smo napihnili čolniček in zapluli not.
content.translation: Matej Blatnik took us to see one of the lovelier and easier caves nearby—Zelške Caves. We entered beneath the Small Natural Bridge in Rakov Škocjan. Outside, we inflated a small boat and paddled in.

content.source: Zelške jame so vodni jamski sistem, v njih teče voda iz Jamskega zaliva Cerkniškega jezera, ki najprej teče skozi sistem jam
content.translation: Zelške Caves are a water cave system carrying water from Jamski Zaliv at Lake Cerknica, which first flows through the cave system of

content.source: Velike Karlovice
content.translation: Velike Karlovice

content.source: , ki smo jo tudi obiskali nekaj dni kasneje. Voda, ki priteče iz Zelških jam se preimenuje v reko Rak, in je del porečja Ljubljanice.
content.translation: , which we also visited a few days later. The water flowing out of Zelške Caves becomes the River Rak and forms part of the Ljubljanica river basin.

content.source: Raziskave v Zelških jamah so se začele leta 1957 in do takrat so bile poznane tudi pod drugimi imeni (Zadnje jame, Grotte del principe Ugo, Grotte Prinz Windischgreatz). Gre za tip jame s stalnim izvirom, sistem pa je bil raziskan v dolžino 7338 metrov in globino 160 metrov. Jama je odprta z nadzorovanim vstopom.
content.translation: Exploration of Zelške Caves began in 1957; until then they were also known by other names (Zadnje Jame, Grotte del principe Ugo, Grotte Prinz Windischgreatz). This is a cave with a permanent spring, and the system has been explored for 7,338 metres in length and 160 metres in depth. The cave is open with controlled access.

content.source: Jama je enostavna in prostorna. Za pristop s čolnom je sicer pri nas najbolj turistična Križna jama, med Cerkniškim in Loškim poljem. Ampak Zelške jame niso nič manj čudovite.
content.translation: The cave is easy and spacious. Križna Cave, between Cerknica and Lož Poljes, is our best-known tourist cave approached by boat, but Zelške Caves are no less wonderful.

content.source: Trikrat smo sicer mogli čoln nesti do naslednjega jezera.
content.translation: We did, however, have to carry the boat to the next lake three times.

content.source: Tudi Matej Blatnik je posnel nekaj čudovitih slik, na katerih sva z Ano gor.
content.translation: Matej Blatnik also took some wonderful photographs featuring Ana and me.

8.title: Sorica

content.translation: Soriška Planina is a launch site for paraglider pilots aiming to make Slovenia's longest cross-country flights. It was my first time here, and the forecast was poor because of strengthening wind and afternoon storms, so I flew only locally. After an hour in the air, hail began to fall.
